column3: No, it's fine. Have you finished psyching yourself up?
Huh? ...Ah, yes... I did, I did!
The truth is, I saw Kuroneko earlier.
Yeah. There was something weird about her, so I got concerned... But it's fine. It seems like there's nothing to worry about.
I said it was fine, but...
It's stuck in my mind, and I just can't seem to shrug it off...
